reason: Routes agent tasks across configured model tiers using observed task outcomes and error counts, with optional automatic model overrides and persistent routing statistics.

summaries.zh: 根据任务历史结果和错误记录，在配置的模型档位之间为智能体选择更合适的模型，并可选地自动覆盖模型路由。
summaries.en: Routes agent tasks across configured model tiers using historical outcomes and error records, with optional automatic model-selection overrides.

capabilities: Observes agent tasks, selected models, tool results, and errors within the agent scope
Persists aggregated routing statistics to eco_router.json
Provides an eco_route tool that recommends a lower-cost model based on historical error records
Optionally overrides model selection during agent requests
Provides runtime settings for model tiers and automatic routing
